name: SBCCORP
recent: SBCCORP 近期主要是一系列股东大会结果公告，以及一项间接全资子公司 Kiara East Property Sdn. Bhd. 出售物业的交易，该交易已获吉隆坡联邦直辖区土地工作委员会同意，买卖协议转为无条件。公司也发布了季度业绩报告。
notable: Kiara East Property Sdn. Bhd. 出售物业予 MEGX，已获吉隆坡联邦直辖区土地工作委员会同意，买卖协议转为无条件。
公司召开第36届常年股东大会，所有决议以投票方式通过。

recent_en: SBCCORP's recent updates mainly comprise a series of AGM outcomes and the disposal of a property by its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Kiara East Property Sdn. Bhd., which has obtained consent from the Kuala Lumpur Federal Territory Land Working Committee, making the SPA unconditional. The company also released quarterly results reports.
notable_en: Kiara East Property Sdn. Bhd. disposed of a property to MEGX; consent from the Kuala Lumpur Federal Territory Land Working Committee was obtained and the SPA became unconditional.
The company held its 36th Annual General Meeting and all resolutions were passed by poll.
